title: The Creep Tapes Season 2
overview: Season 2 of The Creep Tapes on Shudder brings back the mysterious wolf-mask-obsessive serial killer, Josef (Mark Duplass), in six new found-footage tapes. It leans deeper into dark comedy and bizarre, awkward situations while upping the ante with more twisted, riotous, and unpredictable antics
